title: Mapping Commutes with List Lookup
statement: Let $l$ be a list of natural numbers, let $f$ map natural numbers to Booleans, and let $i$ be an index less than the length of $l$. Applying $f$ to the entry of $l$ at index $i$ gives the same Boolean as looking up index $i$ in the list obtained by applying $f$ to every entry of $l$, with default value false.
hypotheses_covered: The index $i$ is less than the length of $l$
